items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Dick Allen. My right name is Richard Binion Allen... I ask Tim a question

ctx.x: This is the building of the Department of Archives and History in Jackson. This is a meeting room. Mm-hmm. Where they show films and have symposium meetings and that sort of thing.

Yeah. So, really what we're trying to do today is to break him in and talk, how to do an interview and about music and we're going to talk about music in Mississippi among other things. Oh, that's great. Even though I'm doing it for Tulane, I think it would be nice for Johnny to hear how we operate. Operate the opportunity. No, not at all. I didn't put down my name, too. My name is Dick Allen. My right name is Richard Binion Allen, but I don't like to give the whole thing too often. It's not a very euphonious…
Well, that's a little early for me. I was, uh, I was working on the, uh, war bond drive with the Boy Scouts. Really? Helping raise money for Uncle Sam.
